title: How the Spring IoC Container Works
contentMd:
The Spring IoC container is the heart of the framework. Inversion of Control means objects no longer create or look up their own dependencies; an external container hands them over. The two core interfaces are BeanFactory, which provides the basic dependency injection engine, and ApplicationContext, which adds event publishing, internationalization, AOP integration and automatic BeanPostProcessor registration.

At startup the container reads configuration metadata from XML, @Configuration classes or annotated components, and turns each declaration into a BeanDefinition. A BeanDefinition is a recipe, not an instance: it records the class name, scope, constructor arguments, lazy flag and init or destroy callbacks. BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementations can inspect and modify these recipes before any object exists.

Instantiation happens eagerly in finishBeanFactoryInitialization, which walks the bean names and creates non-lazy singletons. Each bean goes through property population, then BeanPostProcessors before and after initialization, then @PostConstruct. The three-level singleton cache, made of singletonObjects, earlySingletonObjects and singletonFactories, lets Spring expose a half-built bean to break circular dependencies.

This design explains two classic interview answers. Field injection is discouraged because the container, not your class, controls wiring. Self-invocation bypasses @Transactional because cross-cutting behaviour lives in a proxy that wraps your bean. Once you understand BeanDefinition and BeanPostProcessor, auto-configuration, transactions and caching all make sense.
contentCn:
Spring IoC 容器是整个框架的心脏。控制反转的含义是：对象不再自己创建或查找依赖，而是由外部容器把依赖交给它。两个核心接口是 BeanFactory，它提供最基础的依赖注入引擎；以及 ApplicationContext，它在前者的基础上增加了事件发布、国际化、AOP 集成以及 BeanPostProcessor 的自动注册。

启动阶段，容器从 XML、@Configuration 类或带注解的组件中读取配置元数据，并把每一条声明转换成一个 BeanDefinition。BeanDefinition 是一份配方而不是实例：它记录了类名、作用域、构造器参数、懒加载标志以及初始化和销毁回调。BeanFactoryPostProcessor 可以在任何对象被创建之前检查并修改这些配方。

实例化是在 finishBeanFactoryInitialization 中提前完成的，它会遍历所有 bean 名称并创建非懒加载的单例。每个 bean 都要经历属性填充、初始化前后的 BeanPostProcessor，最后是 @PostConstruct。由 singletonObjects、earlySingletonObjects 和 singletonFactories 构成的三级单例缓存，让 Spring 能够提前暴露一个尚未构造完成的 bean，从而打破单例之间的循环依赖。

这个设计解释了两道经典面试题的答案。之所以不推荐字段注入，是因为控制权在容器而不在你的类中；之所以自调用会绕过 @Transactional，是因为横切逻辑存在于包裹你 bean 的代理里。一旦理解了 BeanDefinition 和 BeanPostProcessor，自动配置、事务和缓存就都能串起来了。
titleEn: How the Spring IoC Container Works
titleCn: Spring IoC 容器是如何工作的

title: Constructor, Setter and Field Injection in Spring
contentMd:
Spring supports three injection styles. Constructor injection passes collaborators as constructor arguments, setter injection calls a setter after instantiation, and field injection writes directly into a private field annotated with @Autowired. Since Spring 4.3, a class with a single constructor does not even need the annotation.

Constructor injection is the recommended default. It lets you declare dependencies as final fields, produces an object that is fully initialized the moment it exists, and makes the class trivially testable because you can just call new in a unit test. It also surfaces circular dependencies immediately with a BeanCurrentlyInCreationException instead of hiding them.

Setter injection suits optional or reconfigurable dependencies, and is common in XML-era configuration and in framework support classes. Field injection is concise but has real costs: you cannot instantiate the class without reflection or a container, the dependency is hidden from callers, and the field cannot be immutable.

When several candidates match a type, resolve the ambiguity with @Qualifier, @Primary, or by naming the parameter after the bean. A practical rule to quote in an interview: constructor injection for required collaborators, setters for optional ones, and avoid @Autowired on fields except in tests.
contentCn:
Spring 支持三种注入方式。构造器注入把协作者作为构造器参数传入；setter 注入在实例化之后调用 setter 方法；字段注入则直接写入被 @Autowired 标注的私有字段。从 Spring 4.3 开始，如果一个类只有一个构造器，连注解都可以省略。

构造器注入是推荐使用的默认方式。它允许你把依赖声明为 final 字段，保证对象在诞生的那一刻就是完整初始化的，并且让类极易测试，因为在单元测试里直接 new 就可以了。它还能立刻暴露循环依赖，抛出 BeanCurrentlyInCreationException，而不是把问题藏起来。

setter 注入适用于可选或可重新配置的依赖，在 XML 时代的配置和框架的支撑类中很常见。字段注入写起来简洁，但代价是真实的：离开反射或容器就无法实例化这个类，依赖对调用方不可见，而且字段无法做到不可变。

当多个候选者都匹配同一个类型时，可以用 @Qualifier、@Primary，或者把参数名写成 bean 的名字来消除歧义。面试里可以说的一条实践准则是：必需的协作者用构造器注入，可选的用 setter，除测试代码外不要在字段上使用 @Autowired。
titleEn: Constructor, Setter and Field Injection in Spring
titleCn: Spring 中的构造器注入、setter 注入与字段注入

title: Understanding Spring Bean Scopes
contentMd:
A bean scope decides how many instances the container creates and how long they live. Spring defines singleton, prototype, request, session, application and websocket. Singleton is the default: one shared instance per container per bean definition, created eagerly at startup unless it is marked lazy. It is not the Gang-of-Four singleton, because it means per container, not per class loader.

Prototype returns a fresh instance on every getBean call or injection point. Spring creates it, wires it, and then forgets it: the container never calls @PreDestroy on prototypes, so any cleanup such as closing a connection becomes the caller's responsibility.

Request, session, application and websocket scopes only exist in a web ApplicationContext. Request creates one instance per HTTP request, session one per user session, and application one per ServletContext. They are backed by a scope implementation registered in the container and are usually exposed through ObjectFactory or a scoped proxy.

The classic trap is injecting a request-scoped or prototype bean into a singleton. The singleton is built once, so it captures a single instance forever. Spring solves this with a scoped proxy, using proxyMode on @Scope, or by injecting ObjectProvider and calling getObject at use time. Remember that thread safety is still your job: singletons should be stateless.
contentCn:
Bean 的作用域决定了容器创建多少个实例以及它们的存活时间。Spring 定义了 singleton、prototype、request、session、application 和 websocket。singleton 是默认值：每个容器中每个 bean 定义对应一个共享实例，除非标记为懒加载，否则在启动时就被创建。它不是设计模式里的单例模式，因为它表示的是每容器一份，而不是每类加载器一份。

prototype 在每次调用 getBean 或每个注入点都返回一个全新的实例。Spring 负责创建和装配它，然后就把它忘了：容器永远不会对 prototype 调用 @PreDestroy，因此关闭连接之类的清理工作必须由调用方承担。

request、session、application 和 websocket 这几种作用域只存在于 web 环境的 ApplicationContext 中。request 每个 HTTP 请求一个实例，session 每个用户会话一个实例，application 每个 ServletContext 一个实例。它们由注册在容器中的作用域实现支撑，通常通过 ObjectFactory 或作用域代理来暴露。

经典的坑是把 request 作用域或 prototype 的 bean 注入到单例里。单例只构造一次，于是它永久地持有了某一个实例。Spring 用作用域代理来解决这个问题，可以通过 @Scope 上的 proxyMode 开启，也可以注入 ObjectProvider 并在使用时调用 getObject。还要记住线程安全仍然是你的责任：单例 bean 应当是无状态的。
titleCn: 理解 Spring Bean 的作用域

title: The Spring Bean Lifecycle Step by Step
contentMd:
A bean in Spring moves through a predictable pipeline. It starts as a BeanDefinition loaded from configuration, then is instantiated by a constructor or factory method, then has its properties and dependencies populated, then runs initialization callbacks, and is finally destroyed when the container shuts down. Interviewers like this question because almost every Spring feature, from AOP to caching, is a hook somewhere along this pipeline.

During initialization the container runs, in order, BeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInitialization, then @PostConstruct, then InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet, then the custom init-method declared by @Bean or XML. Aware interfaces such as BeanNameAware, BeanFactoryAware and ApplicationContextAware are invoked even earlier. This ordering matters when one component depends on another being ready.

AOP proxies are created after initialization by AbstractAutoProxyCreator, which is itself a BeanPostProcessor. That is exactly why calling a @Transactional method from inside the same class does nothing: the call never travels through the proxy, so no advice runs.

On shutdown the container calls @PreDestroy, then DisposableBean.destroy, then the destroy-method. This only applies to singletons, because prototypes are not tracked and their callbacks are skipped. In a non-web application you must register a shutdown hook or call context.close, otherwise your cleanup code never runs.
contentCn:
Spring 中的 bean 会走一条可预测的流程。它先是配置加载出来的一个 BeanDefinition，接着由构造器或工厂方法完成实例化，然后填充属性和依赖，再执行初始化回调，最后在容器关闭时被销毁。面试官喜欢问这个问题，是因为从 AOP 到缓存，几乎每一个 Spring 特性都是这条流程上某个环节的钩子。

在初始化阶段，容器按以下顺序执行：BeanPostProcessor 的 postProcessBeforeInitialization，然后是 @PostConstruct，接着是 InitializingBean 的 afterPropertiesSet，最后是由 @Bean 或 XML 声明的自定义 init-method。BeanNameAware、BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware 这类 Aware 接口的调用时机还要更早。当一个组件依赖另一个组件已就绪时，这个顺序就非常关键。

AOP 代理是在初始化之后由 AbstractAutoProxyCreator 创建的，它本身也是一个 BeanPostProcessor。这正是为什么在同一个类内部调用 @Transactional 方法完全不生效：这个调用根本没有经过代理，因此不会执行任何通知。

容器关闭时会依次调用 @PreDestroy、DisposableBean 的 destroy 以及 destroy-method。这只对单例生效，因为 prototype 不被容器跟踪，其回调会被跳过。在非 web 应用中，你必须注册 shutdown hook 或调用 context.close，否则清理代码永远不会执行。
titleEn: The Spring Bean Lifecycle Step by Step
titleCn: 逐步拆解 Spring Bean 的生命周期

title: @Autowired on Fields vs Constructor Injection
contentMd:
@Autowired on a field, on a setter and on a constructor all ask Spring for the same thing: resolve a dependency by type and inject it. The difference lies in when and how the container does it, and in what that implies for your design and your tests.

Field injection hides the dependency. The class still compiles and can be instantiated with new, but in a plain unit test the field is null and you get a NullPointerException at runtime instead of a compile error. With constructor injection the compiler forces you to supply the collaborator, and the dependency list is visible right in the signature, which also keeps the class honest as it grows.

Immutability is the second difference. Constructor injection allows final fields, giving you a genuinely immutable and thread-safe object. Field injection cannot use final, so the reference can be reassigned, either accidentally or by reflection in tests.

There is also an initialization-order hazard. With field injection, a dependency used inside @PostConstruct may not be ready depending on how the proxy was created, whereas with constructor injection the container must resolve everything before the object exists. Spring Framework code itself uses constructor injection almost exclusively, which is the strongest argument you can cite in an interview.
contentCn:
@Autowired 写在字段上、setter 上和构造器上，向 Spring 表达的是同一件事：按类型解析一个依赖并注入。区别在于容器执行注入的时机和方式，以及这对你的设计和测试意味着什么。

字段注入把依赖藏了起来。这个类依然能编译，也能用 new 创建，但在普通的单元测试里该字段是 null，你会得到一个运行时的空指针异常，而不是编译错误。使用构造器注入时，编译器会强制你提供协作者，而且依赖列表直接写在方法签名里，随着类不断变大，这也能让设计保持诚实。

第二个区别是不可变性。构造器注入允许使用 final 字段，从而得到一个真正不可变、线程安全的对象。字段注入无法使用 final，因此这个引用可以被重新赋值，可能是无意中改的，也可能是测试里的反射改的。

此外还有初始化顺序的隐患。使用字段注入时，在 @PostConstruct 中使用的依赖可能还没有就绪，具体取决于代理的创建方式；而使用构造器注入时，容器必须在对象存在之前就把所有依赖解析完毕。Spring Framework 自身的代码几乎全部使用构造器注入，这是面试中最有说服力的论据。
titleCn: 字段上的 @Autowired 与构造器注入之争

title: How Component Scanning Finds Your Beans
contentMd:
Component scanning is how Spring finds your classes without XML. @ComponentScan, or in Boot the @SpringBootApplication annotation which includes it, tells the container to walk a base package, read every class file, and register a bean definition for each class carrying a stereotype: @Component, @Service, @Repository, @Controller, @Configuration, or a custom annotation meta-annotated with @Component.

The scan itself is performed by ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner, which uses an ASM-based metadata reader. It reads bytecode rather than loading classes, so scanning is fast and never triggers static initializers. Filters let you include or exclude candidates by annotation, assignable type, AspectJ pattern or regular expression.

Stereotypes are more than documentation. @Repository enables persistence exception translation, @Controller is required by Spring MVC handler mapping, and @Configuration marks a class whose @Bean methods must be proxied so that direct calls still return the singleton.

Common problems are easy to recognise. A class outside the scanned package is never registered, which in Boot usually means your main class sits in the wrong package. Two classes with the same simple name collide on the generated bean name. And scanning a huge package tree slows startup. Keep the application class in the root package and use @EntityScan or @EnableJpaRepositories when domain classes live elsewhere.
contentCn:
组件扫描是 Spring 在不写 XML 的前提下发现你的类的机制。@ComponentScan，或者在 Boot 中包含它的 @SpringBootApplication 注解，会告诉容器遍历一个基础包，读取每一个类文件，并为每个带有构造型注解的类注册一个 bean 定义，这些注解包括 @Component、@Service、@Repository、@Controller、@Configuration，或者任何被 @Component 元标注的自定义注解。

扫描工作由 ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner 完成，它使用基于 ASM 的元数据读取器。它读取字节码而不是加载类，因此扫描速度很快，而且不会触发静态初始化器。过滤器允许你按注解、可赋值类型、AspectJ 表达式或正则表达式来包含或排除候选者。

构造型注解并不只是文档。@Repository 会启用持久化异常转换，@Controller 是 Spring MVC 处理器映射所必需的，而 @Configuration 标记的类其 @Bean 方法必须被代理，以保证直接调用时仍然返回同一个单例。

常见的问题也很容易识别。位于扫描包之外的类永远不会被注册，在 Boot 中这通常意味着你的主类放错了包。两个简单类名相同的类会在生成的 bean 名字上冲突。而扫描一棵巨大的包树会拖慢启动。把应用类放在根包下，当领域类位于其他位置时再使用 @EntityScan 或 @EnableJpaRepositories。
titleEn: How Component Scanning Finds Your Beans
titleCn: 组件扫描是如何找到你的 Bean 的

title: @Configuration and @Bean Explained
contentMd:
Spring configuration can be written in Java using @Configuration classes with @Bean methods. A @Configuration class is itself a bean, and each @Bean method declares one bean: the method name is the bean name, the return type is the bean type, and the method parameters are dependencies injected by the container.

The interesting part is that @Configuration classes are subclassed by CGLIB at runtime. The enhanced subclass intercepts calls to @Bean methods and, for singletons, checks the container first: if the bean already exists it returns the cached instance instead of running the method again. This is what makes the common pattern of one @Bean method calling another safe.

If you use @Component or a plain class instead of @Configuration, the methods are not intercepted and every call creates a new object. This is the so-called lite mode, and it is a frequent source of two ObjectMapper or DataSource instances where you expected exactly one.

Use @Bean for anything you do not own: third-party clients, thread pools, ObjectMapper or infrastructure you need to configure in code. Use stereotypes for your own classes. @Bean methods also accept initMethod, destroyMethod and @Scope, and can be made conditional with @ConditionalOnProperty or a profile.
contentCn:
Spring 的配置可以用 Java 编写，也就是使用带有 @Bean 方法的 @Configuration 类。@Configuration 类本身也是一个 bean，每一个 @Bean 方法声明一个 bean：方法名就是 bean 的名字，返回类型就是 bean 的类型，方法参数则是由容器注入的依赖。

有意思的地方在于，@Configuration 类在运行时会被 CGLIB 子类化。增强后的子类会拦截对 @Bean 方法的调用，对于单例 bean 会先检查容器：如果 bean 已经存在，就返回缓存中的实例，而不是再执行一次方法。正是这一点让一个 @Bean 方法调用另一个 @Bean 方法的常见写法变得安全。

如果你改用 @Component 或普通类来声明，方法就不会被拦截，每一次调用都会创建一个新对象。这就是所谓的 lite 模式，也是本该只有一个却出现两个 ObjectMapper 或 DataSource 实例的常见原因。

对于不受你掌控的东西，就用 @Bean：第三方客户端、线程池、ObjectMapper，或者必须在代码里配置的基础设施。自己的类则使用构造型注解。@Bean 方法还支持 initMethod、destroyMethod 和 @Scope，也可以通过 @ConditionalOnProperty 或 profile 变成条件化的。

title: How Spring Boot Auto-configuration Works
contentMd:
Auto-configuration is Spring Boot's answer to the question of why you keep writing the same XML. It is a set of classes, each annotated with @Configuration plus conditional annotations, that Spring evaluates at startup. If a class is on the classpath, a bean is missing, or a property is set, the matching auto-configuration contributes its beans for you.

The mechanism starts with @EnableAutoConfiguration, which is included in @SpringBootApplication. It triggers AutoConfigurationImportSelector, which reads candidate class names from the imports file under META-INF/spring. Each candidate is then filtered by conditions such as @ConditionalOnClass, @ConditionalOnMissingBean, @ConditionalOnProperty and @ConditionalOnWebApplication.

Ordering and user priority matter. Auto-configurations are sorted with @AutoConfigureBefore, @AutoConfigureAfter and @AutoConfigureOrder, and they nearly always use @ConditionalOnMissingBean, which means your own @Bean definition wins and the auto-configuration backs off. That convention over configuration with easy override is the core contract with the developer.

To debug, run with the debug flag or enable debug logging for the autoconfigure package and read the auto-configuration report: it lists positive matches, negative matches and exclusions. You can exclude a specific class through the exclude attribute of @SpringBootApplication or through a property. Many auto-configurations are also bound to properties via @ConfigurationProperties, which is what makes application.yml so powerful.
contentCn:
自动配置是 Spring Boot 对为什么你总要写同样的 XML 这一问题的回答。它是一组类，每个类都标注了 @Configuration 以及若干条件注解，Spring 在启动时对它们逐一求值。如果某个类在类路径上、某个 bean 缺失、或者某个属性被设置了，匹配的自动配置就会替你贡献相应的 bean。

这套机制从 @EnableAutoConfiguration 开始，它被包含在 @SpringBootApplication 中。它会触发 AutoConfigurationImportSelector，该选择器从 META-INF/spring 下的导入文件中读取候选类名。随后每个候选者都要经过条件过滤，例如 @ConditionalOnClass、@ConditionalOnMissingBean、@ConditionalOnProperty 和 @ConditionalOnWebApplication。

顺序和用户优先级都很重要。自动配置类通过 @AutoConfigureBefore、@AutoConfigureAfter 和 @AutoConfigureOrder 排序，而且它们几乎总是使用 @ConditionalOnMissingBean，这意味着你自己定义的 @Bean 会胜出，自动配置主动退让。这种约定优于配置且易于覆盖的特性，就是框架与开发者之间的核心契约。

调试时可以用 debug 开关启动，或者打开 autoconfigure 包的 debug 日志，然后阅读自动配置报告：它会列出正匹配、负匹配和被排除的项。你可以通过 @SpringBootApplication 的 exclude 属性或配置项来排除某个具体的自动配置类。许多自动配置还通过 @ConfigurationProperties 与属性绑定，这正是 application.yml 如此强大的原因。
titleCn: Spring Boot 自动配置的工作原理

title: Spring AOP: JDK Dynamic Proxies and CGLIB
contentMd:
Spring AOP implements cross-cutting concerns such as transactions, caching and security by wrapping your bean in a proxy. Callers receive the proxy, the proxy runs the advice, and then delegates to the real target. Spring uses two strategies: JDK dynamic proxies, which implement an interface, and CGLIB, which subclasses the target class.

With JDK proxies the bean can only be injected as its interface type, so casting to the implementation class throws a ClassCastException. CGLIB avoids that limitation but cannot proxy final classes or final methods, and the target needs a visible default constructor. Spring Boot enables class-based proxying by default, but the distinction still shows up in legacy code and in migration bugs.

A proxy is created by AutoProxyCreator, a BeanPostProcessor that runs after initialization and matches every Advisor, which is a pointcut plus advice, against your bean's methods. Because the proxy wraps the bean, only calls arriving from outside go through the advice. This is the root cause of the two most famous Spring bugs: self-invocation silently ignores @Transactional and @Cacheable, and private or final methods are never advised.

Workarounds include moving the annotated method into another bean, injecting a self-reference, or switching to AspectJ weaving with compile-time or load-time instrumentation. When you debug, remember that a stack frame containing CGLIB or a generated proxy class means you are looking at the proxy, and the real business code is the target one frame below.
contentCn:
Spring AOP 通过把你的 bean 包裹进一个代理来实现事务、缓存、安全等横切关注点。调用方拿到的是代理，代理先执行通知逻辑，再委派给真正的目标对象。Spring 有两种策略：JDK 动态代理，它实现接口；以及 CGLIB，它通过继承目标类生成子类。

使用 JDK 代理时，这个 bean 只能按接口类型注入，因此强转成实现类会抛出 ClassCastException。CGLIB 没有这个限制，但它无法代理 final 类或 final 方法，并且目标类需要有可见的默认构造器。Spring Boot 默认开启基于类的代理，但这个区别仍然会在遗留代码和迁移 bug 中暴露出来。

代理由 AutoProxyCreator 创建，它是一个在初始化之后运行的 BeanPostProcessor，负责把每个 Advisor，也就是切点加通知，与你的 bean 方法进行匹配。由于代理包裹着 bean，只有从外部进来的调用才会经过通知。这正是两个最著名的 Spring 问题的根源：自调用会静默地忽略 @Transactional 和 @Cacheable，而 private 或 final 方法永远不会被增强。

可行的规避手段包括：把带注解的方法移到另一个 bean 中、注入一个自身引用，或者改用 AspectJ 的编译期或类加载期织入。调试时要记住，如果栈帧里出现 CGLIB 或生成的代理类，说明你看到的是代理，真正的业务代码是下一层的目标对象。
titleEn: Spring AOP: JDK Dynamic Proxies and CGLIB
titleCn: Spring AOP：JDK 动态代理与 CGLIB

title: What @Transactional Actually Does
contentMd:
@Transactional adds no code to your class. It marks the bean for proxying, and TransactionInterceptor, which is an AOP advice, opens a transaction before the method and commits or rolls back afterwards. The interceptor asks the PlatformTransactionManager to obtain a transaction and then binds it to the current thread through TransactionSynchronizationManager.

Rollback semantics surprise many candidates: by default Spring rolls back only on RuntimeException and Error. A checked exception does not trigger a rollback unless you declare rollbackFor. And if you catch the exception inside the method and swallow it, the interceptor never sees it and cheerfully commits.

Because it is proxy-based, @Transactional works only on public methods invoked through the proxy. Calling a transactional method from another method in the same class bypasses it, and so does annotating a private, final or static method. Annotating an interface method works with JDK proxies but is ignored when CGLIB proxies the class.

The transaction is bound to a thread, so it does not propagate into a new thread or into an @Async method you start inside it. With a lazily acquired connection, the physical connection is taken when the transaction begins, not at injection time, which is why short transactional methods improve throughput. Use readOnly on queries, and place the annotation on the service layer rather than on controllers or repositories.
contentCn:
@Transactional 并不会往你的类里写入任何代码。它只是把这个 bean 标记为需要代理，而作为 AOP 通知的 TransactionInterceptor 会在方法执行前开启事务，在方法结束后提交或回滚。拦截器会请求 PlatformTransactionManager 获取事务，然后通过 TransactionSynchronizationManager 把它绑定到当前线程。

回滚语义常常让面试者意外：默认情况下 Spring 只在遇到 RuntimeException 和 Error 时回滚。受检异常不会触发回滚，除非你显式声明 rollbackFor。而且如果你在方法内部捕获并吞掉了异常，拦截器根本看不到它，于是愉快地提交了事务。

由于它基于代理，@Transactional 只对接经代理调用的 public 方法生效。在同一个类中从一个方法调用另一个事务方法会绕过代理，标注在 private、final 或 static 方法上同样无效。把注解写在接口方法上对 JDK 代理有效，但当 CGLIB 代理类时会被忽略。

事务是绑定到线程的，因此它不会传播到你新开的线程里，也不会传播到在其中启动的 @Async 方法。采用懒获取连接时，物理连接是在事务开始时才获取的，而不是在注入时，这就是为什么事务方法越短吞吐量越高。查询方法上使用 readOnly，并且把注解加在服务层而不是控制器或仓库层。

title: Transaction Propagation in Spring
contentMd:
Propagation answers this question: what should happen when a transactional method is called while a transaction is already active? You configure it with the propagation attribute of @Transactional, and the seven values of the Propagation enum describe how the manager joins, creates, suspends or rejects the work.

REQUIRED is the default and the right choice for most services: join the existing transaction, or start one if none exists. SUPPORTS runs in a transaction if one is present but does not require it. MANDATORY demands an existing transaction and throws otherwise. NEVER throws if a transaction is active, while NOT_SUPPORTED suspends it and runs non-transactionally, which is handy for a reporting query you do not want holding the same connection.

REQUIRES_NEW always suspends the current transaction and starts a brand-new one. The two are independent: the inner one commits or rolls back on its own, and its outcome does not force the outer transaction to roll back. This is the standard pattern for audit or logging rows that must survive even when the business transaction fails. NESTED instead uses a JDBC savepoint inside the existing transaction, so rolling back the nested block returns to the savepoint while the outer transaction continues.

Two practical warnings. REQUIRES_NEW needs a separate physical connection, so size your pool accordingly. And far more common: if a REQUIRES_NEW method is called from another method in the same class, no proxy is involved and no new transaction is created. Put it in a separate bean and inject it.
contentCn:
传播行为回答的是这样一个问题：当一个事务方法被调用、而此时已经有事务在运行，会发生什么？你可以通过 @Transactional 的 propagation 属性来配置，Propagation 枚举中的七个取值描述了事务管理器如何加入、新建、挂起或拒绝这段工作。

REQUIRED 是默认值，也是大多数服务的正确选择：有事务就加入，没有就新建一个。SUPPORTS 表示如果当前存在事务就在事务中运行，但不强制要求。MANDATORY 要求必须存在事务，否则抛异常。NEVER 在存在事务时抛异常，而 NOT_SUPPORTED 会挂起当前事务并以非事务方式运行，这适合那些你不希望占用同一条连接的报表查询。

REQUIRES_NEW 总是挂起当前事务并开启一个全新的事务。两者相互独立：内层事务自行提交或回滚，它的结果不会迫使外层事务回滚。这是审计或日志行的标准写法，即使业务事务失败，这些记录也必须留存下来。NESTED 则是在已有事务中使用 JDBC 保存点，因此回滚嵌套块只是回到保存点，外层事务仍可继续。

有两点实践提醒。REQUIRES_NEW 需要一条独立的物理连接，所以要相应调整连接池大小。还有一点更常见：如果 REQUIRES_NEW 方法被同一个类中的另一个方法调用，就不会经过代理，也就不会创建新事务。把它放到单独的 bean 里再注入进来。
titleCn: Spring 中的事务传播行为

title: Caching with @Cacheable, @CachePut and @CacheEvict
contentMd:
Spring's caching abstraction sits between your service and a real cache. You enable it with @EnableCaching, declare a CacheManager, and then annotate methods. @Cacheable consults the cache before invoking the method, @CachePut always invokes and updates, and @CacheEvict removes entries, optionally all of them.

The key is generated from the method parameters by a KeyGenerator, by default a SimpleKey of all arguments, or from a SpEL expression such as the id parameter. The condition and unless attributes let you skip caching based on parameters or on the result, for example by skipping null results so that nothing useless is stored.

Caching is also implemented with a proxy, so the self-invocation rule applies again: a @Cacheable method called from inside the same class is not intercepted. Annotate a public method of a bean that you call from outside, or move the cached method into a separate component.

Choose a CacheManager deliberately. ConcurrentMapCacheManager is fine for tests and small local maps, but it never expires and lives only in the current JVM. Caffeine gives you size and time-based eviction locally, while Redis gives you a shared distributed cache with TTL at the cost of serialization and network latency. Interviewers love the consistency question: a cache is never the source of truth, so invalidation on writes is where most production bugs hide.
contentCn:
Spring 的缓存抽象位于你的服务与真正的缓存之间。你用 @EnableCaching 启用它，声明一个 CacheManager，然后给方法加注解。@Cacheable 在调用方法之前先查缓存，@CachePut 总是执行方法并更新缓存，@CacheEvict 则删除条目，还可以一键清空全部。

缓存键由 KeyGenerator 根据方法参数生成，默认情况下是所有参数组成的 SimpleKey，也可以使用 SpEL 表达式，比如取 id 参数。condition 和 unless 属性让你可以根据入参或返回值跳过缓存，例如在结果为空时不缓存，避免把无用的数据存进去。

缓存同样是通过代理实现的，因此自调用规则再次生效：在同一个类内部调用 @Cacheable 方法不会被拦截。请把注解加在会被外部调用的 public 方法上，或者把需要缓存的方法移到单独的组件里。

CacheManager 要慎重选择。ConcurrentMapCacheManager 适合测试和小型本地 Map，但它不会过期，而且只存在于当前 JVM 内。Caffeine 能在本地提供基于容量和时间的淘汰，Redis 则提供带 TTL 的共享分布式缓存，代价是序列化和网络延迟。面试官很喜欢问一致性问题：缓存永远不是事实来源，因此写操作时的失效处理才是生产问题最集中的地方。
titleCn: 使用 @Cacheable、@CachePut 与 @CacheEvict 做缓存

title: The Spring MVC Request Lifecycle
contentMd:
Every request in a Spring MVC application funnels through a single servlet, the DispatcherServlet. It is the front controller: it holds no business logic itself but coordinates a small chain of strategy objects, which is why the pattern is called Front Controller rather than a simple servlet per endpoint.

The sequence is easy to recite. HandlerMapping picks a handler for the request, usually a @RequestMapping method resolved by RequestMappingHandlerMapping. HandlerAdapter then invokes it, performing argument resolution and return-value handling. Argument resolvers turn the HTTP request into method parameters: path variables, request parameters, a request body through a message converter, or a model attribute.

Once the method returns, HttpMessageConverter serializes the result when @ResponseBody or @RestController is present, or a ViewResolver renders a view into HTML. HandlerExceptionResolver deals with anything thrown along the way, which in modern applications means @ControllerAdvice with @ExceptionHandler methods. Interceptors run before, after and on completion around the handler, which is where logging, locale and authentication checks belong.

Servlet filters run before the DispatcherServlet entirely, which is why CORS, compression and Spring Security usually live at the filter level. A useful detail: the servlet holds a WebApplicationContext, and in a classic setup a parent root context holds services while the child holds controllers. In Spring Boot there is a single context and the servlet is registered programmatically.
contentCn:
在 Spring MVC 应用中，每一个请求都会汇集到同一个 servlet，也就是 DispatcherServlet。它是前端控制器：自身不包含任何业务逻辑，而是协调一组策略对象，正因为如此，这个模式才叫前端控制器，而不是每个端点一个 servlet。

这个流程很好背。HandlerMapping 为请求挑选一个处理器，通常是由 RequestMappingHandlerMapping 解析出的 @RequestMapping 方法。随后 HandlerAdapter 调用它，完成参数解析和返回值处理。参数解析器把 HTTP 请求转换成方法参数：路径变量、请求参数、通过消息转换器得到的请求体，或者一个模型属性。

方法返回之后，如果存在 @ResponseBody 或 @RestController，HttpMessageConverter 会把结果序列化；否则由 ViewResolver 把视图渲染成 HTML。HandlerExceptionResolver 负责处理途中抛出的任何异常，在现代应用中这就是带 @ExceptionHandler 方法的 @ControllerAdvice。拦截器在处理器之前、之后以及完成时运行，日志、语言区域和鉴权检查都适合放在这里。

Servlet 过滤器完全运行于 DispatcherServlet 之前，这正是跨域、压缩和 Spring Security 通常处在过滤器层面的原因。一个有用的细节是：这个 servlet 持有一个 WebApplicationContext，在经典结构中父上下文持有服务层，子上下文持有控制器。而在 Spring Boot 中只有一个上下文，servlet 也是以编程方式注册的。
titleCn: Spring MVC 请求生命周期

title: Centralised Exception Handling with @ControllerAdvice
contentMd:
Without a central handler, every controller ends up with try-catch blocks and ad-hoc error payloads. @ControllerAdvice solves this by applying common behaviour, such as exception handling, model attributes and data binding, across a selected set of controllers. You can narrow it down with attributes like annotations, basePackages or assignableTypes.

The usual pattern is one class annotated with @ControllerAdvice, or @RestControllerAdvice which also adds @ResponseBody, containing several @ExceptionHandler methods. Each method declares the exception type it handles and returns a body or a ResponseEntity. Spring picks the most specific handler by exception hierarchy, and you can control precedence between advices with @Order.

A typical handler maps a domain exception to a status code and a stable error contract: an entity-not-found exception to 404, a validation exception to 400 with field errors, and a catch-all handler to 500 while logging the stack trace. Extending ResponseEntityExceptionHandler gives you ready-made handling for the standard Spring MVC exceptions.

Two caveats are worth knowing. Exceptions thrown by a filter, or failures during serialization after the handler has returned, never reach the advice, because they happen outside the handler invocation. And in Spring Security an authentication failure is handled by the filter chain's entry point, not by @ExceptionHandler, so a consistent JSON error body requires configuring both sides.
contentCn:
如果没有统一的处理入口，每个控制器都会塞满 try-catch 和五花八门的错误响应体。@ControllerAdvice 通过把异常处理、模型属性、数据绑定等公共行为应用到一组选定的控制器上来解决这个问题。你可以用注解、basePackages 或 assignableTypes 等属性缩小它的作用范围。

常见的写法是一个标注了 @ControllerAdvice 的类，或者用 @RestControllerAdvice 顺便带上 @ResponseBody，其中包含若干个 @ExceptionHandler 方法。每个方法声明自己处理的异常类型，并返回一个响应体或 ResponseEntity。Spring 会按异常继承体系挑选最具体的处理器，你也可以用 @Order 控制多个 advice 之间的优先级。

典型的处理器会把领域异常映射成状态码和稳定的错误契约：实体未找到映射为 404，校验失败映射为 400 并带上字段错误，再有一个兜底处理器映射为 500 并记录堆栈。继承 ResponseEntityExceptionHandler 可以直接获得对 Spring MVC 标准异常的开箱处理。

有两点值得注意。过滤器抛出的异常，以及处理器返回之后序列化失败产生的错误，永远不会到达 advice，因为它们发生在处理器调用之外。另外在 Spring Security 中，认证失败是由过滤器链的入口点处理的，而不是 @ExceptionHandler，所以要得到一致的 JSON 错误响应体，两侧都需要配置。
titleCn: 用 @ControllerAdvice 做统一异常处理

title: Inside the Spring Security Filter Chain
contentMd:
Spring Security is built entirely on servlet filters. In a servlet application, DelegatingFilterProxy bridges the container's filter lifecycle to a Spring bean named springSecurityFilterChain, which is a FilterChainProxy holding one or more SecurityFilterChain instances. Each request is matched against those chains by URL pattern, and the first matching chain is applied.

A chain is an ordered list of filters, each with a single responsibility. One restores the SecurityContext from the session or a token repository, another processes form login, another handles HTTP Basic, and another handles bearer tokens such as JWT. ExceptionTranslationFilter converts authentication and access-denied exceptions into a 401 or 403 response, and FilterSecurityInterceptor makes the final authorization decision.

Authentication and authorization are separate steps. An AuthenticationManager, usually a ProviderManager, delegates to AuthenticationProviders such as DaoAuthenticationProvider, which loads the user through a UserDetailsService and compares hashes with a PasswordEncoder. The result is stored in the SecurityContext, which by default lives in a ThreadLocal, so it is available in your service code but never travels to a thread you start yourself.

In practice most configuration happens through HttpSecurity: authorization rules, CSRF, session management and OAuth2 resource server support. With Spring Boot a default chain is auto-configured, and adding your own SecurityFilterChain bean replaces it. A frequent interview question is why a custom filter behaves differently depending on where it sits, and the answer is always the documented filter order.
contentCn:
Spring Security 完全构建在 servlet 过滤器之上。在 servlet 应用中，DelegatingFilterProxy 把容器的过滤器生命周期桥接到一个名为 springSecurityFilterChain 的 Spring bean，它是一个 FilterChainProxy，持有一个或多个 SecurityFilterChain 实例。每个请求都会按 URL 模式与这些链做匹配，命中的第一条链会被应用。

一条链是一份有序的过滤器列表，每个过滤器只负责一件事。有的从会话或令牌仓库中恢复 SecurityContext，有的处理表单登录，有的处理 HTTP Basic，还有的处理 JWT 这类 bearer token。ExceptionTranslationFilter 把认证异常和拒绝访问异常转换成 401 或 403 响应，FilterSecurityInterceptor 则做出最终的授权判定。

认证和授权是两个分开的步骤。AuthenticationManager，通常是 ProviderManager，会把工作委派给各个 AuthenticationProvider，例如 DaoAuthenticationProvider，它通过 UserDetailsService 加载用户，并用 PasswordEncoder 比对散列值。结果被存放在 SecurityContext 中，而它默认保存在 ThreadLocal 里，因此在你的服务代码中可以直接取用，但绝不会传递到你自己新建的线程中。

实际开发中大部分配置都通过 HttpSecurity 完成：授权规则、CSRF、会话管理以及 OAuth2 资源服务器支持。使用 Spring Boot 时会有一条默认的链被自动配置，而你自己定义 SecurityFilterChain bean 就会替换掉它。面试官常问为什么自定义过滤器放在不同位置表现不同，答案永远是有文档规定的过滤器顺序。
titleEn: Inside the Spring Security Filter Chain
titleCn: 深入 Spring Security 过滤器链
